blocks.text: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) on Wednesday appealed to the Senate to restore the budget of its Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) program to its 2026 General Appropriations Act (GAA) level of P63.9 billion.
